portal_description:
The oscap-anaconda-addon package provides an add-on that integrates OpenSCAP utilities with the Anaconda installer and allows users to install systems that follow restrictions given by the Security Content Automation Protocol (SCAP).

This update fixes the following bug:

* Previously, the oscap-anaconda-addon package contained unnecessary backup files. With this update, the backup files have been removed from the package. (BZ#1065906)

Users of oscap-anaconda-addon are advised to upgrade to this updated package, which fixes this bug.
